newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Nesher inaugurates $18 mln cement mill.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Nesher inaugurates $18 mln cement mill.

text.p: Cement monopoly Nesher Israel Cement Enterprises inaugurated on Tuesday an $18 million cement mill at its plant in Ramla, near Tel Aviv.
The mill has capacity to produce one million tonnes of cement a year, which will increase Nesher's annual production capacity to seven million tonnes.
Nesher chairman Yossi Rosen said the new mill will allow the company to meet all of the domestic market's demand in the coming years.
The company decided to activate the mill now, when there is a slowdown in the local market due to a decline in demand, in order to meet future needs when demand is expected to rise, he said.
Nesher, which has three plants in Israel, is a subsidiary of Mashav, a 50-50 joint venture of Koor Industries and Clal Industries.
